text: Single API exposes full-text, semantic, and conversational search over your documents and embeddings
quote: It stores your documents and embeddings, then exposes them through fast full-text search, semantic search, and conversational interfaces, all from a single API.

text: Quickstart lets you create an index, add documents, and run your first search in minutes
quote: creating a project and an index, adding documents to it, and performing your first search with the default web interface

text: Typo-tolerant search returns relevant results even with spelling mistakes
quote: Typo tolerance helps users find relevant results even when their search queries contain spelling mistakes or typos, for example, typing `phnoe` instead of `phone`.

text: Seven built-in ranking rules determine relevance and their order can be customized
quote: Meilisearch contains seven built-in ranking rules in the following order: ["words", "typo", "proximity", "attributeRank", "sort", "wordPosition", "exactness"]

text: Synonym lists can be defined so equivalent words return more relevant results
quote: If multiple words have an equivalent meaning in your dataset, you can create a list of synonyms. This will make your search results more relevant.

text: Faceted navigation lets shoppers filter by brand, color, size, and price with live counts
quote: E-commerce faceted navigation: Let shoppers narrow products by brand, color, size, and price range while displaying counts for each option.

text: Dedicated facet-search endpoint powers autocomplete/type-ahead on individual facet values
quote: It is typically used to power auto-complete and type-ahead interfaces on top of filter menus, especially when a facet has too many distinct values to display at once

text: Configuring an embedder auto-generates vector embeddings for every document, no manual embedding pipeline needed
quote: When you configure an embedder, Meilisearch automatically generates vector embeddings for every document in your index. You don't need to compute or manage embeddings yourself.

text: Built-in analytics track search queries, click events, and conversions to measure search quality
quote: Track search queries, click events, and conversions to measure search quality and identify opportunities for improvement.

text: Tenant tokens are scoped, short-lived credentials that restrict each user's search to their own data
quote: Tenant tokens are short-lived, scoped credentials generated from an API key. They embed search rules (filters) that automatically apply to every search request, ensuring users only see their own data.

text: Runs as a single dependency-free binary on Linux, macOS, or Windows, bare metal or containers
quote: Meilisearch is a single binary with no external dependencies. You can run it on any Linux, macOS, or Windows machine, on bare metal or in containers.

text: Native clustering support guarantees read high availability
quote: Guarantees the Read High Availability of the service with native support for clusterization.

text: Geosearch combined with faceting improves result relevancy
quote: Leverage reliable and performant search with features like geosearch and faceting for improved relevancy.

text: Dynamic search rules can boost, pin, or bury results based on the context of each request
quote: Dynamic Search Rules ... Boost, pin, or bury results based on the context of each request

text: Indexes, documents, settings, and searches can be managed via natural-language prompts
quote: Once configured, you can create indexes, add documents, configure settings, and perform searches using natural language prompts.

text: Hybrid search fuses full-text keyword matching with semantic vector search in a single query
quote: Hybrid search combines two search strategies: full-text search (matching keywords) and semantic search (matching meaning).

text: Typo tolerance thresholds can be tuned per index via minWordSizeForTypos
quote: You can override these default settings using the minWordSizeForTypos object.

text: Personalization adapts search results for each user based on their preferences and behavior
quote: Personalization Adapt search results for each user based on their preferences and behavior ... Dynamic Search Rules Boost, pin, or bury results based on the context of each request

text: Facets and filters combine to build interactive, ecommerce-style navigation
quote: Facets are filters that also return distribution data. Use them together to build interactive, ecommerce-style navigation.
